scratch.text: A service whose traffic is PINNED to a revision by name does not cut over on a config-only redeploy. gcloud run deploy created the new revision and reported 'revision [OLD] has been deployed and is serving 100 percent of traffic' -- a true sentence about the OLD revision -- while the new revision got 0% and was retired. Read status.latestReadyRevisionName and the traffic split, never the deploy message.

Byte-identical payloads do not prove a backend flip; both backends served the same content, so a MATCH was satisfied either way. Prove a backend change with an independent witness on the origin being left: after the flip the GCP original logged zero calls while a positive control on the same instrument logged one.

The dashboards backend stamps assertedAt and assembledAt into every response, so a raw-hash before/after comparison reports a clean flip as a failure. Declare the exclusion set and prove it complete by locating every ISO instant and checking it sits under a declared key.
